# Northlight

> Portrait finishing studio at https://photo.dosa.dev. Photos are not stored. Identity is locked. Edits go through xAI Imagine.

## What it is

Northlight is a browser studio for portraits: yearbook proofs, watermarked previews, ID photos, and LinkedIn headshots. Drop, paste, or choose up to 12 JPEG, PNG, or WebP files. Pick a finish. Compare before/after. Download HQ or Print JPG (2×).

Live URL: https://photo.dosa.dev/
Source: https://github.com/QAInsights/photo-app

## Finishes

- Proof clean: watermarks off, grey yearbook backdrop.
- Watermarks only: logos and text off, original backdrop kept.
- HQ enhance: color, light, sharpness. No structural changes.
- Cleanup: glasses glare, flyaways, lint, wrinkles. Subject unchanged.
- Studio grey / white: seamless paper backdrop. Subject unchanged.
- ID photo: passport-style, white backdrop, 3:4 crop.
- LinkedIn: square studio headshot, grey paper.
- Custom: your instructions, identity locked.

## Optional modifiers

- Crop: Auto, 1:1, 3:4, 2:3. ID locks 3:4; LinkedIn locks 1:1. Other finishes keep a manual crop.
- Tone: Color or black-and-white yearbook.
- Retouch: Off, or gentle shine/blemish reduction without reshape.
- Match look: pin a finished photo so later finishes copy lighting and grade, not the person.
- Backdrop: drop a studio-paper photo; the background is taken from that image.

## Identity lock

Every finish keeps the same person: facial features, age, skin tone, hair, eyes, glasses, teeth, jewelry, clothing, pose, and expression. No beautify, age-shift, or identity restyle. Natural skin texture. Photorealistic.

## Privacy

The app does not persist photos. Images you finish are processed per https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy. For now, Studio AI requires a browser-supplied xAI key. It is stored AES-256-GCM in this browser only, sent only with the image request, and can be removed from Settings. Paid credits are planned.

## How to finish a photo

1. Drop, paste, or choose photos (up to 12).
2. Pick a finish. Add Custom instructions if needed.
3. Optionally set crop, B&W, gentle retouch, look, or backdrop.
4. Press Finish photo. Drag the slider to compare. Hold Space to peek the original.
5. Download HQ or Print JPG (2×).

Studio AI calls `https://api.x.ai/v1/images/edits` with `grok-imagine-image-2.0`.
